cohort: Neonates delivered in Southwest Shoa Zone public hospitals in Ethiopia between August and November 2022, categorized as cases with birth asphyxia or controls without birth asphyxia.
finding: Maternal and obstetric factors such as meconium-stained amniotic fluid, pregnancy-induced hypertension, instrumental delivery, post-term pregnancy, induction of labor, and non-cephalic presentation were significantly associated with birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery was significantly associated with birth asphyxia.
